title: Introduce compact credential conductor and cross-SDK stream sugar (py/ts/go) v1.11.0
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Simplify credential lifecycle coordination and make generator/pullstream ergonomics consistent across TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs. This PR introduces a compact 'credential conductor' abstraction in the TypeScript SDK and thin adapters for Python and Go to achieve parity without duplicating runtime logic. The conductor centralizes TTL handling, jittered refresh scheduling, heartbeat hints, and a small resilience policy for transient auth errors. In parallel, we add a minimal 'stream sugar' utilities module (async generator helpers and small backpressure hints) to improve common streaming use cases and to standardize examples across languages. Key outcomes: (1) smaller surface for integrators to reason about credentials, (2) consistent behavior of streaming reconnects and token rotation across languages, (3) coordinated version bumps to align cross-SDK contract. Changes include implementation, tests, docs, examples, and changelogs. Checklist: Implement TS conductor core; expose adapter hook for external credential providers; implement Go and Python adapter shims; add integration tests simulating token expiry + reconnect; update examples in quickstarts; bump SDK versions (TS v1.11.0, Py v2.2.1, Go v1.8.3); update CHANGELOG and release notes; add migration notes to docs. Related work items: ENG-2103 credential orchestration; ENG-2178 stream ergonomics alignment. No product-facing breaking changes expected but consumers using internal credential hooks should follow the migration notes at https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk-migration/cred-conductor. CI: green after re-running flaky integration on 2026-02-16. Merge note: squash merge to keep history compact.

review_comments: Leah O'Connor: Requested unit tests for the fallback path when refresh fails twice; flagged a race in conductor.start() vs explicit shutdown. Asked for clearer docstring around provideCredentials hook.

Ava Martinez: Added deterministic test harness, serialized shutdown in conductor and pushed follow-up commit addressing race. Clarified docstrings and added migration section to docs/migration/cred-conductor.md.

Rohit Singh: Suggested tightening resilience policy parameters and exposing them via Config with safe defaults. Ava updated Config and added note about not relying on defaults for extremely long-lived connections.
Marta Kaczmarek: Approved after small nits (typo in README and one missing example in quickstarts).
release_notes: Introduce credential conductor abstraction and stream sugar utilities. Cross-SDK adapters added for Python and Go. Improve streaming token rotation and reconnect behavior. Bump SDK versions: TS v1.11.0, Py v2.2.1, Go v1.8.3.
notes_on_migration: Consumers who implemented custom credential hooks should switch to the new provideCredentials adapter or call conductor.bindProvider to avoid double-refresh. See docs/migration/cred-conductor.md for examples and an automated codemod for TypeScript.

egress_contracts: TS/py/go adapters maintain the same public call signature for streaming send/receive; minor opt-in Config fields added for conductor tuning.
